_doc: PIMSA architecture instance A = <M, B, P> for UPMEM as simulated by uPIMulator, following the paper's case-study instantiation (Sec. case study, 'Instantiation for UPMEM'). Per-loop-body instruction costs are not listed: they come from the target toolchain (dpu-clang, inst_count_analyzer), looked up by the source anchors of the IR loops. Fields with value null are part of the model but not used by the UPMEM analysis; the 'src' of each says why.
name: UPMEM DPU (uPIMulator)

L.src: paper: root = the shared channel/rank; leaves = DPU-local MRAM partitions. The 8-DPU chip layer is not modeled: it adds no separate bandwidth boundary

I1_dpus.src: uPIMulator: one channel, one rank, 64 DPUs. A deployment parameter: the DPU sweeps use 1..64 and the analysis is per DPU

mram_bytes.src: UPMEM SDK: 64 MB MRAM per DPU

0.src: host-PIM transfer: not in the kernel-only cycle count

1.src: PrIM (Gomez-Luna et al. 2022): MRAM DMA of s bytes costs alpha + beta*s, beta = 0.5 cycles/byte

t_read.src: PrIM: fixed cost alpha of one mram_read

t_write.src: PrIM: fixed cost alpha of one mram_write

j.src: WRAM is attached to each leaf (DPU) node

B.src: one buffer per DPU: the whole WRAM, buffer id b = 0

BSize.src: UPMEM SDK: 64 KB WRAM per DPU; a software-managed scratchpad, so no miss cost

k.src: one DPU per leaf memory node

P.src: one DPU per leaf memory node

W.src: DPU ISA: 32-bit scalar RISC pipeline, no SIMD lanes

D.src: 14-stage pipeline whose last three stages overlap the next instruction of the same tasklet: same-tasklet issue distance 11 (revolver scheduling)

t_op.src: one machine instruction issues per cycle when the pipeline is full

ESize.src: from the build: the TYPE macro gives E (4 bytes for INT32), see prim/common.py

R.src: not used: register reads and writes are inside the machine instruction count

cost._doc: Cost-model parameters of the UPMEM composition (paper: rho_pipe), not hardware properties.

stall_fraction.src: paper: conservative non-memory pipeline stall fraction for the compute upper bound, rho_pipe+ = max(D/T, 1) / (1 - 0.1)

exec._doc: How PIMSA-IR runs on this target.

trigger.src: each tasklet fetches and executes its own instruction stream

parallel.src: a parallel region over tasklets: each tasklet runs its own instance (interleaved by the revolver pipeline)

memory_operands.src: instructions operate on WRAM and registers; MRAM is reached only by DMA (mram_read / mram_write)

transaction_bytes.src: MRAM DMA moves 8 B units (mram_read/mram_write sizes are multiples of 8); uPIMulator counts MRAM reads and writes in these units

cost.src: per-loop-body machine instruction counts E_b from dpu-clang (pim_model/inst_count_analyzer); trip counts n_b from PIMSA-IR
